units.source_text: 由于战败的冲击，民族的悲哀，金阁显得更是超绝非凡。

en.t: Because of the shock of defeat and the sorrow of the nation, the Golden Pavilion seemed all the more transcendent and extraordinary.
Or perhaps it only pretended to be transcendent and extraordinary.

units.source_text: 迄今，金阁还是这样子，终于免遭空袭的洗劫，

en.t: Until now, the Golden Pavilion had remained this way, having finally escaped the devastation of air raids,

units.source_text: 从今以后也不用再担心，无疑就是这些原因使金阁重新恢复了这样的表情，

en.t: and from now on there was no need to worry anymore; without doubt, these were the reasons that made the Golden Pavilion recover that expression once again,

units.source_text: 即"自古以来我就坐落在这里，未来也许仍然永远屹立在这里"。

en.t: as if to say, "Since ancient times I have stood here, and in the future perhaps I will still stand here forever."
